_comment: The extension's whole reach, pinned. CI rebuilds this from manifest.json and fails if the
two disagree, so widening what the extension can touch is a line in a diff with this file
next to it rather than a key somebody added while doing something else.
Why these: `proxy` installs the PAC, which is the only reason any of this works in a
browser. `storage` holds the port and the control token. `http://127.0.0.1/*` is the
daemon and nothing else -- no host permission over any site is asked for, which is what
lets the extension claim it cannot read the pages it routes. `web_accessible_resources`
names one origin, the bare suffix, so the front door may open the dashboard and remote
HTML served from a host may not.
There are no content scripts. Nothing is injected into a page the reader came for.
